Mega Evolution series · DLR

Delta Reign

Released November 6, 2026 · 141 cards

Expanded

Delta Reign is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on November 6, 2026. Its main set has 103 cards, plus 38 secret rares numbered beyond the set (141 in total). It includes 114 Pokémon, 24 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

90 illustrators worked on Delta Reign. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (16), nagimiso (3), Sanosuke Sakuma (3), Souichirou Gunjima (3), akagi (2), AKIRA EGAWA (2), aky CG Works (2), Aliya Chen (2).
